newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: New Zimbabwe banking act expected by early 1998.
newsitem.headline: New Zimbabwe banking act expected by early 1998.

text.p: Zimbabwe's long-awaited new banking act will be in place by early next year, central bank governor Leonard Tsumba said.
In an interview, Tsumba said the central Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe (RBZ) had been consulting industry on the new law over the last three years and the work on it was now at an advanced stage.
"We expect this legislation to be in place before the end of the year or at the latest by early next year," he said.

The aim of the new law, Tsumba said, was to strengthen the central bank's hand in supervising the southern African nation's growing private banking sector which has seen several merchant banks being established in the last four years.
The new law would also be in line with banking acts around the world, meant to ensure security of public investments, he said.
"That to us is very important. We subscribe to that...and the legislation will address that question to reassure the world," he added.
